en.title: Jesus is Nailed to the Cross
en.meditation:
Consider how Jesus, after being thrown on the Cross extended His hands, and offered to His Eternal Father the sacrifice of His death for our salvation. These barbarians fastened Him with nails, and then, raising the Cross, allowed Him to die with anguish on this infamous gibbet.

My Jesus! loaded with contempt, nail my heart to Thy feet, that it may ever remain there, to love Thee, and never quit Thee again. I love Thee more than myself; I repent of having offended Thee. Never permit me to offend Thee again. Grant that I may love Thee always; and then do with me what Thou wilt.
en.versicle: We adore Thee, O Christ, and we bless Thee.
en.response: Because by Thy holy Cross, Thou hast redeemed the world.
en.source: eCatholic2000.com, "The Way of the Cross" by St. Alphonsus de Liguori, https://www.ecatholic2000.com/liguori/stations/cross.shtml, retrieved 2026-08-23

fr.title: Jésus est cloué à la croix
fr.meditation:
Considérons comment Jésus, renversé sur la croix, étend les mains et offre au Père éternel le sacrifice de sa vie pour notre salut. Ces bourreaux l’attachent avec des clous, élèvent ensuite la croix, et le font mourir sur ce cruel et infâme gibet.

Mon Jésus outragé, placez mon cœur tout près du Vôtre, afin qu’il n’oublie jamais Votre amour et ne cesse jamais de Vous aimer.
fr.versicle: Nous t’adorons, ô Christ, et nous te bénissons,
fr.response: parce que tu as racheté le monde par ta sainte Croix.
fr.source: spiritualite-chretienne.com, "Chemin de Croix avec les meditations de St Alphonse de Liguori" (site now defunct/repurposed; archived via Wayback Machine, e.g. https://web.archive.org/web/20200221112546/http://www.spiritualite-chretienne.com/croix/stat-c01.html), retrieved 2026-08-23 -- provisional pending AELF licence, per content/README.md (meditation); Diocese de Saint-Etienne (diocese-saintetienne.fr), "Chemin de Croix", https://www.diocese-saintetienne.fr/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Chemin-de-croix.pdf, retrieved 2026-08-23 -- provisional pending AELF licence, per content/README.md (versicle/response)
